title: Tormented Souls 2
summary: Tormented Souls 2 is the fixed-camera survival horror sequel from Dual Effect, published by PQube and released on Switch 2 on October 15, 2026, both digitally and at retail. The US eShop lists a 24.6 GB download, and the physical edition is a Game-Key Card, so the cartridge does not hold the game. You can play with classic tank controls and limited saves or switch to an assisted mode. No resolution or frame-rate figures have been published; Game Tyrant's handheld review says it looks good and runs smoothly, better than on Steam Deck, with only some stiff animations.
